messages:
edr-bot: [EDR ALERT] Host ALX-MBP15 (alex) - heuristic PowerShell obfuscation detected. Quarantined C:\users\alex\appdata\local\temp\tmp1234.exe. MD5: abcdef1234567890
maria: Got alert, assigning SOC oncall. @oncall-soc can you take initial triage? Any known false-positive?
oncall-soc: Oncall SOC here. Pulling telemetry, isolating host from network. Alex, did you click any suspicious links or install anything just before the alert?
alex: I was testing a local build earlier, then Slack popped an alert. Didn't click unknown links. I can step away from laptop and hand it over.
tyler: Maria / @oncall-soc — pushing remote scan now. Command: `edrctl scan --host ALX-MBP15 --deep`. Posting results when done.
edr-bot: Scan finished: 3 items quarantined, 1 autorun entry removed, heuristic tag "PS_Obf" matched. Outbound to weirdcdn[.]info blocked. No large data exfil detected (<=12MB).
sophie: Recommend full disk image before any reimage. If user consents, collect EDR snapshot + sysinfo and chain-of-custody note.
maria: Agreed. @tyler please create host snapshot and upload to secure bucket (s3://redwood-forensics/reports). Open ticket INC-2025-234 and mark P2.
tyler: Snapshot started (ETA ~25m). Created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2025-234. Labels: edr, macos, quarantine.
alex: Thanks. Rough ETA on return to service?
oncall-soc: We'll try to preserve dev env; if binary is malicious we'll reimage. Otherwise we'll clean + validate. ETA ~4 hours.
maria: Post-incident actions: add YARA rule for hash abcdef1234567890, update internal allowlist for verified dev builds, run org-wide IOC scan tomorrow. @sophie add to weekly security digest.
sophie: Will add. Also schedule a 24h follow-up to review audit logs and validate RBAC token rotations for service accounts used in alex's workflow.
